threads.body: This file explicitly says to keep the version in sync with the `org.graalvm.buildtools.native` plugin version in `settings.gradle.kts`. As part of this bump, ensure the plugin version in `settings.gradle.kts` is also updated to `1.1.8`; otherwise you can end up with mismatched plugin/runtime behavior (especially around reachability metadata resolution).
threads.hunk:
@@ -10,7 +10,7 @@
 import org.graalvm.buildtools.gradle.dsl.GraalVMReachabilityMetadataRepositoryExtension
 
 // Keep this in sync with the org.graalvm.buildtools.native plugin version in settings.gradle.kts.
-val graalvmReachabilityMetadataVersion = "1.1.7"
+val graalvmReachabilityMetadataVersion = "1.1.8"

threads.body: The GraalVM build tools version now appears in multiple places (this dependency and the conventions script constant), which makes drift more likely. Consider centralizing this version in one place (e.g., a version catalog entry or a shared Gradle property) so both the dependency and the reachability metadata version can reference the same value.
